title: SEALGuard: Safeguarding the Multilingual Conversations in Southeast Asian Languages for LLM Software Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical safety alignment and the development of a guardrail (SEALGuard) and benchmark (SEALSBench) for detecting unsafe and jailbreak prompts in LLMs. While it includes 'discriminatory and hateful expression' as a safety category and cites bias-related benchmarks like BBQ, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or specific philosophical moral systems.
